name: H00_crow_enters_mills_two_of_your_own
note: Crow of Dark Tidings: 'When this creature enters or dies, mill two cards.' Cast from hand with exactly its cost ({2}{B}): the enters trigger puts the top two cards of ITS CONTROLLER's library into that player's graveyard, once. The opponent's library is untouched and the Crow itself stays on the battlefield.
